# OMA-AI

> One gateway. Every model. No lock-in. OpenAI-compatible AI inference with
> wallet-based auth and USDC pay-per-request on Base (x402). Privacy-first:
> zero data retention on prompt content. Self-hostable.

## Overview
- Product: https://oma-ai.com
- API base URL: `https://api.oma-ai.com/v1`
- OpenAI-compatible: drop-in for `openai-python`, `openai-node`, Vercel AI SDK,
  LangChain, raw `fetch`, and any HTTP client.
- Auth: Magic link email, SIWE wallet, and API keys. x402 pay-per-request supported.
- Model catalog: 18 curated chat models (12 Venice + 6 OMA-AI budget tier)
  (see live list at https://oma-ai.com/models).
- Brand: Open Model Access · accent `#46d39a` · void `#07090a`
- Brand kit sources: `/logos/oma-wordmark.svg` (SVG + PNG), `/logos/oma-brand-card.svg` (SVG + PNG), `/favicon.svg`

## Drop-in clients (best practice)
```bash
# OpenAI-compatible (OpenCode, Cursor, openai-python, Vercel AI SDK)
export OPENAI_API_KEY="oma_sk_…"
export OPENAI_BASE_URL="https://api.oma-ai.com/v1"

# Anthropic-compatible (Claude Code, Anthropic SDK)
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="oma_sk_…"
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://api.oma-ai.com"   # client appends /v1/messages
```
Use live model ids from `GET /v1/models` (e.g. `llama-3.3-70b`, `claude-sonnet-5`, `minimax-m2.7`).

## Modalities
| Modality | Endpoint | Pricing |
|---|---|---|
| Chat completions | `POST /v1/chat/completions` | From $0.015 / 1M input tokens |
| Image generation | `POST /v1/images/generations` | $0.10 / image |
| Video generation (async) | `POST /v1/videos/generations` | $0.92 / generation |
| Video retrieve | `GET /v1/videos/retrieve` | free |
| Web search (DuckDuckGo) | `GET /v1/search?query=…` | Free / no key |

## Payment rails
1. **Card credits (Polar)** — Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay. Three plans: Hobby $10 / 1k credits, Builder $50 / 5k, Scale $250 / 25k. See `/pricing`.
2. **USDC on Base** — direct 1:1 USD deposits. Cross-chain routing via LI.FI / CCTP is planned, not currently enabled.
3. **x402 pay-per-request** — agent-native USDC settlement on Base. EIP-3009 gasless. No account required.

## Protocols
- OpenAI-compatible (drop-in for openai-python, openai-node, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain)
- Anthropic-compatible (`/v1/messages` for Claude Code)
- A2A (`.well-known/agent-card.json`)
- A2UI v0.9.1 (interactive UI in chat)
- OpenAI + Anthropic protocols (see /docs#integrations)

## Endpoints
| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `/v1/chat/completions` | POST | Chat completions (streaming + tool calls) |
| `/v1/messages` | POST | Anthropic-compatible messages (Claude Code) |
| `/v1/images/generations` | POST | Image generation |
| `/v1/videos/generations` | POST | Async video generation |
| `/v1/videos/retrieve` | GET | Poll async video job |
| `/v1/search` | GET | Web search (`?query=…`); optional auth for chat |
| `/v1/models` | GET | List available models and capabilities |
| `/v1/models/:id` | GET | Single model detail |
| `/v1/balance` | GET | Credit balance (Bearer auth) |
| `/v1/credits/balance` | GET | Active credit batches + balance |
| `/v1/credits/transactions` | GET | Combined deposit + usage history |
| `/v1/usage` | GET | Paginated usage history (session or Bearer auth) |
| `/v1/usage/today` | GET | Daily free-tier counter |
| `/v1/deposit/usdc` | GET / POST | USDC deposit instructions / submit tx |
| `/v1/deposit/status` | GET | Deposit history |
| `/v1/export/usage` | GET | Usage export (CSV/JSON, session auth) |
| `/v1/export/deposits` | GET | Deposit export (CSV/JSON, session auth) |
| `/v1/keys` | GET / POST | List API keys / create key (`oma_sk_...`) |
| `/v1/keys/:id` | DELETE | Revoke API key |
| `/v1/keys/install` | POST | Install key as HttpOnly cookie |
| `/health` | GET | Liveness probe |
| `/x402/verify` | POST | Verify x402 payment receipt |

## Authentication
Three modes, all served by the same endpoints:

1. **API key** — `Authorization: Bearer $OMA_KEY`. Low-friction signup at
   [oma-ai.com/login](https://oma-ai.com/login).
2. **Session** — cookie-based session for browser chat (magic link or SIWE wallet).
3. **x402 pay-per-request** — agent-native USDC settlement on Base. No
   pre-funded account required for single-shot agent calls.

## Pricing model
Pay-as-you-go credits. Buy credits with card / Visa (via Polar) on the
[deposit page](https://oma-ai.com/deposit), or deposit USDC on Base (x402,
EIP-3009). Cross-chain routing via LI.FI / CCTP is planned but not currently
enabled. x402 supports agent-native pay-per-request on Base. Per-model input/output rates are
listed on `/models` and `GET /v1/models`.

## Chat UI
The [chat playground](https://oma-ai.com/chat) supports an optional **UI
mode** that renders live A2UI (v0.9.1) surfaces — the model can build
interactive cards, forms, and previews inline. Enable it with the toggle
above the composer.

## Agent setup
- [Agent skill file](https://oma-ai.com/agent-skill.md): copy-paste instructions for AI agents to autonomously set up and use OMA (API key flow, x402 pay-per-request flow, cost guidance).
- [Agent card (A2A)](https://oma-ai.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): machine-readable capabilities, auth schemes, payment config for agent discovery.
